value.draft: To determine if trial results are published, first check the trial registry's "published results" section. Next, review any journal articles listed in the trial record. Finally, consult the trial's primary publication source, such as a peer-reviewed journal or official report. These steps will help confirm whether results have been made public and where they can be accessed.
